capabilities: Add inline tooltips to words using custom syntax
Pin tooltips open by clicking and dismiss them by clicking again
Manage reusable tooltip dictionaries scoped to a note or folder
Share tooltips across synonyms of a word
Wrap selected text in tooltip syntax via an editor command
extras: README is bilingual (English and Russian); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach custom hover descriptions to arbitrary words or phrases in notes.
summary: Tooltip plugin that adds hoverable, Markdown-formatted descriptions to words via inline syntax and reusable note- or folder-scoped dictionaries.
